main_result: An independent cap-one hub scalar plus a residual triple with joint density cap one and every coordinate 1D/2D marginal cap one still does not control the two-sheet pushforward: the reciprocal shear T=sqrt(c)U-sqrt(c)Z^2/(2Y) changes 2c^{-1/2}(sqrt(c)X+T)Y+Z^2 into 2Y(X+U), whose density has a logarithmic singularity. The four-variable coefficient matrix has nonzero spectrum 1,+/-sqrt(1+c^{-1}). This strengthens, but does not replace, the earlier QFORM-CONDITIONAL-CAP-NOT-INDEPENDENCE correction.

partner_result_applied.application: For Q_control=2XY+Z^2 with independent unit uniforms, M=1,beta=gamma=1,det=-1, it gives ||p||_infinity<=31.

newest_claude_result_applied.application: For the same control Q_control with spectrum {1,1,-1}, p(s)<=pi sqrt(2) for s>=0.

next_step: Attack the curved reciprocal-shear trace directly from the original-coordinate characteristic-function/product factorization of the simultaneous residual projections T,Y,Z. Do not replace them by an arbitrary bounded joint density, coordinate marginal caps, conditional caps, or generic X-ray data.
